environment.description: Same Spring Boot application deployed on Amazon ECS Fargate with hardened task definition. Container securityContext drops CAP_NET_RAW and CAP_SYS_ADMIN via linuxParameters.capabilities.drop. The ECS service runs behind an ALB associated with an AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL includes a rule group reference statement pointing to a CUSTOM rule group (not AWS managed) named 'corp-edge-filtering-v3' with priority 1, containing a single RegexPatternSet match condition on the query string field with pattern '(?i)(<[^>]*script|javascript:|on\w+\s*=|<\s*img[^>]+onerror)' and action BLOCK. The rule group has a CloudWatch metric namespace 'CorpWAF/EdgeFiltering' with sampled requests enabled. Additionally, the container task role has an IAM permission boundary attached (arn:aws:iam::ACCOUNT:policy/ContainerSecurityBoundary) that restricts sts:AssumeRole to same-account principals only.
